facts.text: I completely agree that the setting can truly make or break a graphic novel.
I have a favorite graphic novel called Watchmen.
Watchmen uses an alternate history 1980s America setting.
I think the gritty urban atmosphere in Watchmen adds to the overall mood of the story.
I think the gritty urban atmosphere in Watchmen makes the story feel more real and impactful.
I read a comic once that took place during the Chernobyl disaster.
I felt that even though the Chernobyl disaster comic was fictional, it felt grounded in reality because of the setting.
